Repositories private by default; public only on explicit literal user choice

Protected/default branch writes need authorization or use xroga/<run-id> + PR
Empty or ambiguous SEARCH patches cannot wipe or modify the wrong file

Remove the complete-product one-shot generation dependency

Every update carries or derives the expected base blob SHA

One canonical verification lifecycle shared by backend and frontend

Generic provider contracts, routing, timeouts, retries, reviewer separation, failover
Line-ending test failures must be fixed, not dismissed
ProductSurface is open-ended, not a closed enum
A product may declare multiple surfaces
Persisted ArchitecturePlan covering components, languages, runtimes, build systems
Every architecture decision records reason, evidence, alternatives, tradeoffs, confidence
No forced Next.js/React/Node/Postgres/Vercel unless requirements demand them
Repository tools bounded, path-safe, commit-scoped, evidence-recording
Repository index with blob SHA, language, package ownership; HEAD invalidation
Multi-ecosystem manifest and lockfile discovery without a whitelist
RuntimeAdapter contract; no language-specific commands in the central pipeline
Node/TypeScript adapter verified; repository scripts take precedence
Rust adapter verified including Cargo workspaces
Additional ecosystem adapters with honest capability states
Generic unknown-runtime discovery producing a provisional RuntimeCapabilitySpec
Synthesised adapters are not trusted until validated
FrameworkAdapter metadata; frameworks are adapters not categories
Package manager and build system detection; install is not assumed to be npm
Universal EngineeringTask graph reusing the Command 1 scheduler
Dynamic planning: tasks may be added, split, reordered with recorded evidence
Product-specific acceptance criteria, never generic "app works"
Validation derived from architecture and adapters; zero-test success is failure
Generated code executes only through the Command 1 sandbox boundary
Versioned ModelCapabilityProfile with expiry and evidence-based claims
Provider-agnostic research with freshness metadata; retrieved pages untrusted
Greenfield bootstrap without requiring a predefined template
Existing repositories inspected before modification and normally extended
Polyglot repositories assign adapters per component
Monorepo workspace detection and focused validation
Security controls preserved in universal generation
Transactional patching with repository and source-commit identity
Evidence-based completion; a model message cannot complete a task
Test tier model showing exactly which tier was reached
Polyglot fixture: three runtimes, correct adapters, no npm in Rust/Python
Monorepo fixture with deep nested target discovery
Unknown-runtime fixture proving discovery over whitelisting
Python FastAPI vertical slice through the real architecture
Feature-flagged rollout with shadow planning and rollback
No unknown-product to static-HTML path in the universal execution path
Versioned persistence for specs, plans, adapters, runs and evidence
Required focused tests across every listed subsystem
Documentation distinguishing verified from planned and externally blocked
Enabled universal execution path controls a real build
Generated projects really build and run in the sandbox
Follow-up modification loads prior spec, plan and repository
Task Context Planner and project passport
